items.title: Palworld is finally leaving early access - here's when
items.description:
It's finally happening: Palworld is leaving early access on 10th July.

Read more

items.title: Studio behind Martha is Dead, the game too extreme for PlayStation, debuts gameplay from its psychological serial killer horror When Sirens Fall Silent
items.description:
LKA, the studio behind 2016's acclaimed The Town of Light and its controversial 2024 follow-up Martha is Dead, has shared first gameplay of its next project. When Sirens Fall Silent is a psychological serial killer horror and it's coming to PC next year.

Read more

items.title: Acclaimed co-op series Trine is returning for a fresh adventure with new and familiar faces, and a heist that goes wrong
items.description:
If your life's been lacking a bit of colour lately, have no fear: developer Frozenbyte's acclaimed co-op platforming series Trine is back for a sixth outing, and once again it's the aesthetic equivalent of a Dulux catalogue. It's not too far off release either. Trine 6: Together in Time, in all its kaleidoscopic glory, comes to PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and PC on 17th September.

Read more

items.title: Yooka-Laylee is back in a SNES-style kart racer from some of the team behind Diddy Kong Racing
items.description:
It's somehow been seven years since Yooka-Laylee's last proper adventure (I'm not sure 2025's remake, as enjoyable as it was, entirely counts), but the bat and lizard duo are finally back, and this time in a brand-new form. Yes, those recent leaks were right: we're in for some classic SNES-style kart racing action when the now-officially announced Super Yooka-Laylee Kart arrives for PC at some currently undisclosed future time.

Read more

items.title: IO Interactive's James Bond game 007 First Light sells 2.7 million copies in its first week, as dev reiterates free Year One content
items.description:
007 First Light is already racking up some pretty impressive sales figures for IO Interactive. Today, in a presentation given to the press after the Summer Game Fest 2026 showcase, IO studio director Hakan Abrak told Eurogamer that the game sold 2.7 million copies in its first week on sale - and is now 'closer to 3 million copies sold'.

Read more

items.title: Aion 2's global release date announced at Summer Game Fest
items.description:
Aion 2 - the sequel to legendary Korean MMORPG Aion - has had its global release date revealed at Summer Game Fest.

Read more

items.title: The Wolf Among Us 2 finally arrives next year, a decade after it was announced, but a remaster of the acclaimed original is coming first
items.description:
It's finally happening, apparently. After a protracted and extremely tumultusous decade of development, The Wolf Among Us 2 is supposedly now launching next year. And there's a remaster of the much-loved original on the way to tide us over until then.

Read more

items.title: Monster Hunter Ascendance is to Wilds what Iceborne was to Monster Hunter World, coming 2027
items.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds' first expansion, Ascendance, has finally been revealed. In a trailer at Summer Games Fest 2026, Capcom unveiled the future of the game with a massive new expansion called Ascendance.

Read more

items.title: Maverick Games reveals Clutch, an open-world racer set in the rather gorgeous-looking French Riviera
items.description:
Clutch - the cinematic, open-world, action-driving game from the team at Maverick Games, and which is being headed up by former Forza Horizon creative director Mike Brown - just got itself a very slick new trailer at this evening's Summer Game Fest, showing of its rather lovely rendition of Monaco and the French Riviera.

Read more

items.title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake Part 3 is called Revelation, coming to PS5, Xbox and Switch 2 simultaneously Spring 2027
items.description:
Square Enix has finally announced, as part of today's Summer Games Fest showcase, some more information about the third instalment of Final Fantasy 7 Remake series. It's called Final Fantasy 7 Revelation

Read more

items.title: Stellar Blade Blood Rain takes a big swing with a Summer Game Fest reveal trailer
items.description:
Stellar Blade Blood Rain has just been revealed at Summer Game Fest, with an action-packed new gameplay trailer.

Read more

items.title: Saw's the latest movie to get the asymmetrical horror game treatment and it's coming from Silent Hill 2 remake studio Bloober Team
items.description:
So far, Dead by Daylight is the only one that's managed to stick, but that hasn't stopped the deluge of asymmetrical horror games from continuing to flow. And now it's Saw turn to try its luck where others have failed in the newly announced Saw: Genesis, which is on the way courtesy of Silent Hill 2 developer Bloober Team.

Read more

items.title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush announced at Summer Game Fest, launching later this year
items.description:
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush has just been announced at Summer Game Fest.

Read more

items.title: Gundam is getting a flashy new action game with Gundam Rogue Orbit, coming 2027
items.description:
Gundam Rogue Orbit has been revealed with an exciting new gameplay trailer at Summer Game Fest.

Read more

items.title: After the success of Black Myth: Wukong and Wuchang: Fallen Feather, Swords of Legends aims to elevate the Chinese action-RPG even further
items.description:
Tonight during the Summer Game Fest showcase, developer Aurogon Shanghai unveiled a brand new trailer for the upcoming action-adventure RPG Swords of Legends.

items.title: Patrice Désilets has unveiled 1666: Amsterdam, which includes some very angry looking cats
items.description:
At this evening's Summer Game Fest showcase, Panache Digital Games and Patrice Désilets gave us all a trailer for 1666: Amsterdam.

items.title: The next Virtua Fighter finally got a proper name and a fancy trailer at Summer Game Fest
items.description:
Sega's next big Virtua Fighter game finally has a proper name, which has been revealed alongside a fancy new trailer.

Read more

items.title: Guild Wars 3 announced at Summer Game Fest, beta releasing in Fall 2027
items.description:
Guild Wars 3 has been announced at Summer Game Fest. It will be playable through a beta come fall 2027.

Read more

items.title: Crossfire is a new tactical, single-player action game from former Modern Warfare 2019 and Naughty Dog leads
items.description:
Crossfire was revealed today during Summer Game Fest's opening ceremony. This is the debut title from That's No Moon, an independent studio featuring key talent behind the 2019 Modern Warfare reboot's campaign, and Naughty Dog before that.

Read more

items.title: Here's our best look yet at Alien: Isolation 2 as one of the greatest horror games ever prepares to return
items.description:
On Alien: Isolation's 10th anniversary a couple of years ago, director Al Hope shared some exciting news: a very long-awaited sequel was finally in development. Beyond that, we learned little else. Earlier this year, however, we got our first teaser trailer, and today, during Summer Game Fest's big showcase extravaganza, we've had our best look yet at Alien: Isolation 2.

Read more

items.title: Three years later, that 'dark' Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin game gets a first trailer, and it's being created by Bayonetta studio Platinum Games
items.description:
Some three years after it was announced an unnamed developer was taking the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles in a darker video game direction with a project inspired by the well-regarded TMNT graphic novel The Last Ronin, the game has finally - albeit vaguely - been unveiled. And it turns out the mysterious team behind it is none other than famed Bayonetta, Nier: Automata, and Ninja Gaiden 4 developer Platinum Games.

Read more
category: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin

items.title: Netease action stunner Blood Message gets gorgeous cinematic trailer at Summer Game Fest
items.description:
Blood Message - the upcoming action adventure game by Netease - just got a stunning new trailer at Summer Game Fest.

Read more

items.title: Cuphead 2 in the works at Studio MDHR, as well as a new arcade shooter based on the series
items.description:
A new hand-animated Cuphead game is in development from Studio MDHR. The news was shared with a short segment during this evening's Summer Game Fest showcase. This upcoming game will take Cuphead's characters on a "fresh, exciting adventure".

Read more

items.title: Fumito Ueda, legendary developer behind Shadow of the Colossus and Ico, announces single-player epic Gen Atlas for Xbox, PlayStation, and PC
items.description:
Fumito Ueda, the creator of Ico, Shadow of the Colossus and The Last Guardian, revealed his next sci-fi project at tonight's Summer Game Fest - the first big information drop we've seen about the game since its reveal back at The Game Awards 2024.

Read more

items.title: Resident Evil: Code Veronica Remake announced at Summer Game Fest, coming in 2027
items.description:
Resident Evil: Veronica has been announced at Summer Game Fest. The game will release in 2027 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

Read more

items.title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Ted Lasso star Anthony Head dies aged 72
items.description:
British actor Anthony Head, known widely for his portrayal of Giles in the Buffy the Vampire Slayer, has died from complications due to pneumonia, aged 72 years old.

Read more

items.title: Xbox boss Asha Sharma still can't seem to decide on a stance regarding console exclusivity
items.description:
Newly-appointed Xbox CEO, Asha Sharma, has now spent over 100 days in her new role. Speaking recently at Bloomberg Tech Live, the executive was asked yet again about the company's stance on exclusivity for first-party games, and whether or not this can even be managed when Microsoft is also one of the largest third-party publishers in the world.

Read more

items.title: Marathon Deluxe Edition discount offers free-trial players bonuses without the full game, confusion ensues
items.description:
Some confusion around Marathon's Deluxe edition appears to be popping up, as a discounted deluxe edition version of the game bought by many PlayStation users does not actually include the full game.

Read more

items.title: "We are seeing a certain degree of effectiveness from the use of generative AI" - Capcom clarifies its stance on using the controversial tech
items.description:
Capcom has said why it is using generative AI in its business, stating its policy is "to improve the efficiency of routine operations so that our developers can devote more time to essential value creation".

Read more

items.title: Summer Game Fest 2026 live report - all the news and announcements from Geoff Keighley's big night
items.description:
The centre-piece show of Summer Game Fest - the literal Summer Game Fest showcase - takes place tonight at 10pm UK time (11pm CEST / 5pm EDT / 2pm PDT), and we'll be covering all the news and announcements from it, live, right here in this article. There may be a pre-show; it's unconfirmed.

Read more

items.title: June's PlayStation State of Play breaks records, is reportedly the most-watched ever
items.description:
Sony has successfully made its State of Play showcase series into a brand that brings in millions of views with each episode. The most recent showcase, which took place 2nd June ahead of Summer Game Fest 2026, was apparently its biggest-ever, no matter which way you measure it.

Read more

items.title: Yet another new Crimson Desert update is here, and this one adding Pinball, because of course
items.description:
Pearl Abyss is on quite the Crimson Desert patch roll, and has just released another update for its popular single player RPG spin-off from hit Korean MMO Black Desert. Just last week, the developer added the ability to remap your controller, and now it is gone and added new minigames and more.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation 5 hardware sales dropped dramatically in the UK last month vs Xbox
items.description:
Current-generation Xbox hardware sales have been low in all major markets, registering its worst-ever year in the UK last year. Fortunes almost turned in May, however, a month when PlayStation suffered a big drop in its own sales.

Read more

items.title: Steam Machine and Steam Frame both shipping "this summer", Valve affirms
items.description:
Valve intends to release its Steam Machine and Steam Frame this summer.

Read more

items.title: Subnautica 2 studio "hard at work" on new updates as it shares more details on the features its 4 million players can expect next
items.description:
Subnautica 2 is off to a roaring start, and developer Unknown Worlds recently celebrated the fact that 4m players have now dipped their toes into the waters of the ocean planet Proteus. That's a lot of early access feedback to comb through, but the studio says it's been doing just that and has now shared more details on the changes and major additions it's planning to implement next.

Read more

items.title: Amazon will publish whatever 007 First Light sequels there may be, as it muscles in on IO Interactive's operation as new owner of James Bond
items.description:
UPDATE 6.18pm: Amazon has shared a new statement regarding its relationship with 007 First Light developer IO Interactive and any future Bond games.

Read more

items.title: FromSoftware has finally announced an Elden Ring Switch 2 release date
items.description:
FromSoftware and Bandai Namco Entertainment have finally announced a Switch 2 release date for Elden Ring.

Read more

items.title: Kratos will return in future games, God of War developer assures fans following the Laufey reveal
items.description:
Following the reveal of God of War Laufey, series developer Sony Santa Monica has had to clarify, on multiple occasions, that longtime protagonist Kratos remains the eponymous God of War, and more games starring Kratos are in indeed the works.

Read more

items.title: Nintendo's finally developing replaceable batteries, so we presumably won't have to bin a Switch because the battery conked out
items.description:
Nintendo has announced it is creating hardware with replaceable batteries, which presumably will include its Switch consoles, due to new EU regulations tackling electronic waste.

Read more

items.title: Think you've got a handle on Mina the Hollower? Yacht Club reckons many playthroughs are "missing 50 percent of the game", and "there are a few very secret things" players are yet to find
items.description:
Mina the Hollower may look like a cute and unassuming game at first glance, with its retro pixel aesthetic and demure mouse hero, but don't be fooled. Developer Yacht Club Game has hidden myriad secrets within its world, the Tenebrous Isle, for players to unearth. And even after a week of scrutiny by eager fans, it seems many of these remain undiscovered.

Read more

items.title: "We know players want it. WE want it" - Dune Awakening developers respond to lack of crossplay for console release
items.description:
Dune Awakening developer Funcom has responded to the news crossplay won't be included in the game's upcoming console release, telling Eurogamer, "We know players want it. WE want it."

Read more

items.title: James Bond game 007 First Light sales estimated to have reached an impressive milestone a week after launch
items.description:
007 First Light has been out for just over a week and already it may have surpassed two million copies sold.

Read more

items.title: Here are our Xbox Game Pass games for June
items.description:
Microsoft has revealed the first batch of games coming to its Xbox Game Pass subscription service this June.

Read more

items.title: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight swoops onto Switch 2 this autumn, and its first major DLC arrives the same day
items.description:
After a bit of a wait, Switch 2 owners can get their hands on Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight this autumn, publisher Warner Bros. has announced, as it joins the many other games arriving in September.

Read more
category: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight

items.title: CD Projekt Red's new mystery IP 'Hadar' is "an emotional, open-world experience" in line with the developer's Witcher and Cyberpunk games
items.description:
We've known about Hadar, CD Projekt Red's new franchise, for a few years now, but it wasn't until March 2026 the studio "established the foundations" of what it's actually going to be. With only promises and a codename, little is known about its nature, but another nugget of info has just surfaced.

Read more

items.title: Rayman's best, most beautiful adventure is being remade in 3D, for some reason, and it'll be bundled with the leaked Rayman Origins remaster
items.description:
You probably don't need me to tell you Rayman Legends is an absolute classic. And despite it being over a decade old at this point, the celebrated 2D platformer - with its sumptuous hand-drawn art and wildly imaginative action - still looks and sounds and plays phenomenally today. So it feels a bit odd that, of all the Rayman games Ubisoft could have revisited and remade as the character celebrates his 30th anniversary, it's this one. But here we are anyway with the newly revealed Rayman Legends Retold, coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Switch 2, and PC on 1st October!

Read more

items.title: Nintendo Music now supports PC, tablets, and car screens as a whopping four hours of Mario Kart World bangers join the streaming service
items.description:
Nintendo Music has been around for a good while now, but despite many updates to its musical selection since launch, the streaming service has only been accessible via Nintendo's mobile app. That's now changed.

Read more

items.title: Pokémon gets the Lego Smart Play treatment with new sets arriving this summer, and they're not as eye-wateringly expensive as the previous Pokémon builds
items.description:
Lego Pokémon sets finally arrived earlier this year, but they were on the costly side, with a strong focus on big builds. Of course, that was just the beginning of The Lego Group and The Pokémon Company's partnership, and now they've revealed Lego Smart Play sets that might be a better fit for kids and fans looking to spend less.

Read more

items.title: The X-Men don't exist in Marvel's Wolverine, and while Spider-Man does, he'll only appear fleetingly in an "Easter-eggy" kind of way
items.description:
Seeing Jean Gray in the trailer for Marvel's Wolverine yesterday, and her ability to work with Logan as an ally in combat, naturally gave rise to another question about the game: which other famous X-Men characters will we see?

Read more

items.title: God of War Laufey is bringing back the original trilogy's faster combat
items.description:
Though it takes place in the same world as the 2018 God of War reboot, and God of War Ragnarök, God of War Laufey surprisingly borrows some of the most defining characteristics of the original trilogy.

Read more

items.title: Dune Awakening is coming to consoles at long last, but for some reason, it will not have crossplay
items.description:
Dune Awakening is coming to consoles at long last, and is getting a dedicated single-player mode. Unfortunately, there'll be no crossplay between most platforms.

Read more

items.title: Toy Story is the next series to get Digital Eclipse's acclaimed retro collection treatment, and a remaster of Toy Story 3 is also on the way
items.description:
Following Digital Eclipse's Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection last year, the studio famed for its preservation and restoration work - including the critically acclaimed Gold Master Series - has unveiled a collection of retro Toy Story titles, plus a standalone "modern remaster" of Toy Story 3. Both are set to launch this October, as part of Toy Story's 30th anniversary celebrations.

Read more

items.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis comes with an AI disclaimer
items.description:
UPDATE 5.31pm: Crystal Dynamics has provided Eurogamer with a comment on its AI use in Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. While the developer did not share specifics on what it used the technology for, a Crystal Dynamics representative told Eurogamer:

Read more

items.title: Fallout 76 is finally getting native PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions with improved graphics and performance, but Bethesda needs to test them first
items.description:
Fallout 76 has had quite the evolution over the years, slowly but steadily going from a "broken mess" to becoming what is essentially seen as 'Fallout Online', complete with proper questlines and wandering friendly NPCs. Despite all the new content and improvements, however, players were still waiting for proper PS5 and Xbox Series X/S upgrades, and finally, they're almost ready to go.

Read more

items.title: Marathon season 2 suffers rocky launch thanks to rampant errors and bugs
items.description:
Marathon season 2 launched yesterday evening, bringing with it sweeping changes to the core game as well as a full progression reset and new modes to leap into. It also, sadly, came with heaps of bugs.

Read more

items.title: "I don't think we can ask people to pay $30 for a pixel art game" - How Mina the Hollower's modest $20 price point may have saved developer Yacht Club Games
items.description:
Mina the Hollower sold 300,000 copies in three days over its launch weekend, with developer Yacht Club Games assuring it is going to be "fine" after previously saying this game would be "make-or-break" for the studio.

Read more

items.title: Stuntman Hollywood revealed at Sony State of Play, coming soon to PS5
items.description:
Stuntman Hollywood - an explosive return for the beloved racing series - has been revealed at tonight's State of Play livestream.

items.title: The leaks were real:  God of War Laufey is all about Faye, and it's coming to PlayStation 5 'soon'
items.description:
Sony Santa Monica has announced its next God of War game. It's known as God of War Laufey, and was revealed as part of this evening's PlayStation State of Play.

Read more

items.title: A decade later, PlayStation's cult classic cinematic horror hit Until Dawn is returning with a fully fledged, sun-kissed sequel
items.description:
Over a decade after cult-classic cinematic horror game Until Dawn launched for PS4, Sony has revealed a sequel is in the works, and it's out on PS5 next year.

Read more

items.title: The Lost Wild - a dinosaur survival horror game by former Alien: Isolation developers - announced at Sony State of Play
items.description:
The Lost Wild - a new dinosaur survival horror game - has just been announced at Sony's State of Play.

Read more

items.title: Control Resonant's release date revealed in bombshell Sony State of Play story trailer
items.description:
The release date for Control Resonant has been revealed, as part of a new trailer shown off at tonight's Sony State of Play event.

Read more

items.title: Silent Hill: Townfall has a PS5 release date, and things are getting scary in very foggy Scotland this September
items.description:
Silent Hill's long-awaited resurgence has seen a strong start thanks to Bloober Team's Silent HIll 2 remake and developer Neobards' Silent Hill f. So hopes are high for the survival horror series next outing, Silent Hill Townfall, which is now confirmed to be releasing for PlayStation 5 on 24th September.

Read more

items.title: For the first time in its 25-year history, Runescape comes to PlayStation 5 this year with survival game RuneScape Dragonwilds
items.description:
Jagex announced, as part of today's PlayStation State of Play showcase, that its survival game RuneScape: Dragonwilds will make series' history and be the first Runescape game to land on consoles - ever.

Read more

items.title: Ace Combat 8 soars onto the Sony State of Play with a new release date trailer
items.description:
A new trailer for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve has been revealed at today's Sony State of Play livestream. As part of this trailer, we now know the game will release on the 2nd October, 2026.

Read more

items.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis gets new trailer featuring Lara, Natla and Larson, as well as slight a delay
items.description:
At this evening's PlayStation State of Play we were treated to another look at Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. Legacy of Atlantis is the upcoming remake of the original Tomb Raider, which was unveiled at The Game Awards in December.

Read more

items.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword gets September release date, and a playable demo available right now
items.description:
After months of teasing, we finally have a release date for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. As per Sony's latest State of Play showcase, the 1500s-Japan-set action-RPG is scheduled for release 25th September, on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. And there is a demo live, and available to play, right now.

Read more

items.title: Marvel's Wolverine gets gruesome with over seven minutes of uninterrupted gameplay footage, and he's bought a familiar X-Men pal
items.description:
Honestly, it feels like forever ago (time, eh?) developer Insomniac announced it would be following up its excellent Spider-Man games by taking on a very different kind of Marvel hero. But five years later, Wolverine is almost ready to pounce, and the studio is stoking excitement for the PS5 game's September release with our first chunk of uninterrupted gameplay - seven minutes, in fact - which includes the arrival of a familiar X-Men face.

Read more

items.title: Magneto, Green Goblin, and Carnage announced for Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls at Sony State of Play
items.description:
A big Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls reveal has happened at tonight's Sony State of Play livestream, with Magneto, Green Goblin, and Carnage joining the launch roster.

Read more

items.title: Super Yooka-Laylee Kart leaks ahead of Summer Game Fest as developer Playtonic Games teases "there may be faster ways to go"
items.description:
Summer Game Fest 2026 is happening this week, and while that usually means we can ready ourselves for plenty of surprise video game reveals, invariably not everything will manage to stay a secret until its big day. And it looks like developer Playtonic's Yooka-Laylee series is the latest to get leaky, with a Yooka-Laylee kart racer seemingly coming soon.

Read more

items.title: Subnautica 2 gets first hotfix to tweak the behaviour of certain creatures
items.description:
Subnautica 2 has rolled out a new hotfix, the third since it launched into early access a little over two weeks ago. This particular update is special, however, as it's the first to arrive following the debate among players about whether or not you should be able to defend yourself from fish attacks, rather than avoid them.

Read more

items.title: Crimson Desert DLC officially in development at Pearl Abyss as the studio surprises everyone by agreeing to change the game's story
items.description:
Crimson Desert continues to grow and evolve following both financial success and player feedback, simultaneously squashing issues and adding more content to a game that was already dense at launch. Now, Pearl Abyss has confirmed the plans for this summer and beyond, including an actual piece of DLC.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation State of Play live report - all of today's news from Sony's 2026 summer showcase
items.description:
Sound the horn, for the summer gaming festivities are about to begin. Sony goes first with its PlayStation State of Play showcase, which starts tonight at 10pm UK time (that's 11pm CEST/2pm PDT/5pm EDT). And we'll be covering it in this article, live, bringing you all the news and announcements as they happen.

Read more

items.title: Pokémon TCG announces 30th anniversary set with "all foil cards", 30 new unique Pikachu illustrations, and the return of classic Charizard
items.description:
The Pokémon Company has revealed "a commemorative expansion" for Pokémon TCG which celebrates the Pokémon series' 30th anniversary. It'll hit stores worldwide on 16th September this year, and I'll bet we're going to see fights over these boosters.

Read more

items.title: New data shows Sony has been selling fewer and fewer copies of its PlayStation exclusives since 2020
items.description:
Sales of PlayStation's first-party exclusive games have been on the decline since the company's 2020 fiscal year, according to new data, only registering a brief spike last year (2025). That perceptible drop is notable, in part because Sony has always positioned PlayStation as the only place to play some of the best games, many of which were produced by its own in-house studios which the platform holder invested billions into.

Read more
category: The Last of Us Part II Remastered

items.title: Valve antitrust lawsuit reportedly reveals lengths Steam owner is willing to go to prevent cheaper prices elsewhere
items.description:
Steam is once again under fire. A new antitrust lawsuit has accused platform owner Valve of abusing its dominant position in the PC marketplace by aggressively pursuing developers - including major players like Ubisoft and Warner Bros. - who fail to maintain price parity across digital storefronts.

Read more
category: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X

items.title: Resident Evil Requiem producer suggests the legendary horror series could finally visit Japan in the future - "I think every member [of the team] has given it some thought"
items.description:
Despite coming from a Japanese studio, the Resident Evil series has never dipped its toe into Japan, at least in terms of a game's setting. However, Resident Evil Requiem's producer thinks every member of Capcom's development team has at the very least considered the idea, and the series could well go there in the future.

Read more

items.title: Streets of Rage movie gains momentum as Sonic the Hedgehog writers and The Harder They Fall director board the adaptation
items.description:
Though you may have forgotten about it, a Streets of Rage movie has been in the works since 2022. Originally, Hollywood's current go-to action screenwriter Derek Kolstad (of John Wick fame) was attached. Now, the slow-moving project has evolved and recruited two new writers, plus a director.

Read more

items.title: Star Wars Jedi 3 rumour suggests we might see an older Cal Kestis after a time jump, which lines up with recent promises of "more Cal stories"
items.description:
We've known for a long time that a third Star Wars Jedi game is in active development, but the planned length of the series and the fate of Jedi survivor Cal Kestis - a hero who isn't available by the time Luke Skywalker takes on Darth Vader and the Empire - are unclear. Recent chatter might have given us some clues though.

Read more

items.title: EA announces national line-up for FC 26's unofficial world cup mode
items.description:
EA has announced the national team line-up for its unofficial world cup mode, which will kick off on the 4th June.

Read more

items.title: The Witcher 3's acclaimed Blood and Wine expansion was almost called something entirely different
items.description:
Acclaimed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion Blood and Wine was originally called Bells of Beauclair, with its final name only being settled on midway through production.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine

items.title: As Path of Exile 2 player numbers surge, Grinding Gear Games promises it won't forget about Path of Exile 1
items.description:
As player numbers leap alongside Path of Exile 2's final early access update, and the game's prospective 1.0 release later this year, a question arises about the future of Path of Exile 1. Will it be elbowed out? In short: no. Grinding Gear Games intends to support the older action role-playing game "as long as there are players" playing it and believes it's capable of running both games smoothly side by side.

Read more

items.title: "The PC is being reinvented" - Nvidia announces new AI-focused RTX Spark chip for laptops as widespread doubt bubbles
items.description:
Nvidia has announced the RTX Spark computer chip, which it claims will revolutionize personal computing thanks to its AI capabilities.

Read more

items.title: Blizzard surprises with meta-shaking StarCraft 2 update after years of quieter support and fixes - "Some of these changes are wild"
items.description:
As one of the best real-time strategy games of all time, StarCraft 2 is far from dead, but 2020 marked the end of content development for Legacy of the Void and the base free multiplayer experience. Since then, a few more balance patches have hit, but it's been a few years since the last major shakeup. Now, Blizzard Entertainment has surprised everyone with a shocking update.

Read more
category: StarCraft II: The Legacy of the Void

items.title: We may learn the Steam Machine launch date very soon, as Steam's backend just got updated with a welcome tour
items.description:
The Steam Machine, once thought to be targeting the first quarter of 2026, was pushed back earlier in the year to an indefinite date - even if maker Valve continued to insist the PC-in-console-clothing remains on track for release in 2026. The new target instead shifted to the first half of the year.

Read more

items.description:

items.title: Infinity Ward sneakily offers first look at Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer gameplay, and apparently it's all about movement now
items.description:
Modern Warfare 4 developer Infinity Ward has been firing off episodes of its quasi-documentary series, From the Ward, at a rapid pace since the game's reveal last week. The show, filmed at the studio, has so far offered some insight into the development of the campaign, the ethos of multiplayer, and… the creation of the new design of long-serving character Ghost.
